cohort: Nulliparous women (N = 701), 18 years of age or older, who gave birth at 37 to 41 weeks gestation to live, singleton fetuses in the vertex presentation
finding: Induction of labor was a significant predictor of cesarean birth, even after controlling for age and body mass index.
mod_finding: Women with spontaneous onset of labor and Bishop score ≥ 8 were more likely to have a vaginal birth.
